description: The main colours in an image, like the site’s Palette: HEX, RGB, HSL, how much of the picture each covers, and contrast against white and black, plus CSS variables. Transparent areas are ignored; colours are measured from a downscaled copy, so tiny details may not register. Also saves a swatch card PNG (name-palette.png) in ~/Downloads/one-design.

count.description: How many colours to find (2 to 12). Near-identical ones are merged, so you may get fewer.

files.description: Image files or folders (a folder means the images in it). ~ is your home folder.

order.description: "dominance": most used first. "light": dark to light.

name: extract_palette
title: Extract a colour palette
